items.heading: The café deficit became a budget decision
items.subheading: The money table defended the deficit for forty minutes. Then someone asked what the same goodwill would cost to buy any other way, and nobody had an answer. After that the table stopped arguing about whether to keep the café and started deciding how much it may cost.

items.heading: Three tables said the same thing about why people renew
items.subheading: Membership, money and programme each arrived separately at recognition: people stay because someone knows their name. Once it was said in plenary, the pricing, welcome and programme conversations started pointing at the same goal instead of three different ones.

items.heading: Two members found out they had never been in the building on the same day
items.subheading: It started as a joke and stopped being one. Three years of membership each, opposite weekdays, no overlap. The atmosphere problem the morning kept circling turned out to have a timetable underneath it.
